scope: Prototype implementation checks; not participant research or hardware validation

reports.name: handoff-checks
checks: Keyboard selects overnight and morning; morning names Ring and shows last-sync routing.
Missing-night state is shared bidirectionally with the day viewer; sleep preview-off suppresses the Watch estimate.
Disconnected mode withholds new estimate and current battery; Ring-only uses iPhone; reset restores scenario while preserving larger text.
Mobile moment selection reveals and focuses the resulting companion heading when below the viewport.

reports.name: handoff-journeys
checks: Desert on the page opens Desert in the viewer; choosing Black in the viewer survives closing and reopening on both surfaces.
Viewer access choices propagate to the page and setup. Setup starts with current choices; draft changes apply only on Continue.
Larger text, missing-night selection, active panel, reflection, and source disclosure survive return paths.
Main Today follows the selected moment; source labels follow the device combination.
Reset restores the finish, data choices, day, fixture, reflection, and setup without reloading; larger text and manual motion reduction remain selected.
Choices are in-memory for the visit; a reload restores defaults without persisted records.
